# bin

CLI entry points and launcher scripts for local-router and PQC secrets.

## Purpose

- `bin/local-router.js` — primary start/stop/status CLI.
- `bin/localrouter.js` — legacy router script.
- `bin/pqc-secrets` — PQC secrets wrapper.
- `bin/fvs-code.js`, `bin/lib/localrouter-client.js` — launcher/client utilities.

## Ownership

- Maintained by local-router team.

## Local Contracts

- Node CLI scripts; keep them POSIX-portable.

## Work Guidance

- Use for user-facing start, stop, status, route-set commands.
- PQC secrets binary must never log key material.

## Verification

- Smoke test `bin/local-router.js status` after deploy.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files are required.
